scope: Actual RTC snapshot/default-clock get/registry timestamp adapter and frontend init/std0..6/hexdump/dequeue/panic -> pool -> RTT backend -> serial -> format/calendar/printf -> RTT ring, including deferred/immediate and bounded ring backpressure
limitations: Clock/RTC registration binding and counter updates are controlled fixtures; actual native/source RTC snapshot, registry, timestamp adapter, default get and logger backend record/API execute. Optional host consumption occurs only between public calls; no live debugger/RTC or physical timing proof.
Only valid standard/hexdump packets and bounded sequential traces are admitted; malformed packets, complete application startup and real interrupt/task concurrency remain unproven.
Unresolved board providers are test-only traps and are not executed. Whole-image linking, original compiler identity, duplicate layout and byte equality remain gates.
